Indian athlete Seema Punia wins bronze medal at CWG

Indian athlete Seema Punia won a bronze medal in the discus throw event at the Commonwealth Games. Punia, who holds a PhD and is a mother of a three-year-old child, secured the medal for India. The coverage highlighted her achievements alongside her personal background.
